newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon positive on WorldCom.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon positive on WorldCom.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it "aggressively" reiterated its strong buy rating on WorldCom Inc.
-- said WorldCom has very strong business momentum as it enters 1997.
-- said the integration of WorldCom and MFS Communications Co has proceeding more smoothly than expected. The two telecommunications firms completed their merger on Dec 31.
-- WorldCom is uniquely positioned, since it has an "unmatched array of assets on which to execute a strategy of being a global supplier of telephony and internet services to business customers."
-- said WorldCom is positioned to gain significant market share.
-- WorldCom gained 1-1/8 to 27-1/4 in heavy trading.
